purpose: Truy lineage và coverage toàn snapshot; chưa xác minh ứng dụng/image/deployment sinh dataset.
metadata_note: Chỉ ghi bảng đề xuất suy từ metadata đọc trong bộ nhớ; không lưu response nguồn mới. Nhóm theo đường dẫn là phân loại sơ bộ CHƯA KIỂM bằng nội dung.

ob_selection.extraction: raw file bytes, no archive or .git; JAR retained as file, no expanded disk tree
ob_selection.verification: size + git blob identity against pinned whole tree, then SHA256 task manifest; do not substitute branch HEAD
ob_selection.independence: OPEN; candidate application is associated with Nezha by published repository description; no dataset deployment proof
ob_selection.lfs: OPEN until source contents are approved and checked; tree has no gitlinks

nezha_selection.reason: Bổ sung tài liệu/install/config và code analysis chưa có; truy pipeline, không chạy Nezha hoặc tải dữ liệu.
nezha_selection.excludes: Reuse existing verified README/paper/4 analysis source files/LICENSE. No rca_data/construct_data/log/metric_threshold, template .bin, TT config or labels. These exclusions prevent independent lineage/host claims if producing code is absent.

metadata_to_fetch_after_approval.identity: re-query for record only; pin must remain proposed commit, not latest
provenance check only; not revision selection
canonical tree corresponding to unchanged commit

costs.transport_wire_bytes: OPEN; HTTP/TLS overhead, metadata drift and retries not included in exact payload sum.
costs.jar_uncompressed_entry_peak_ram: OPEN; inspect ZIP directory after approval; no full extraction proposed
costs.all_attempts_disk: No finite guaranteed total before attempts occur. Working estimate includes 3 complete acquisition attempts, 3 comparison passes and 50 MiB checkpoint/log budget; failed/repeated runs retained.

failure_conditions: Any missing file/changed blob/extra external source: retain failed attempt, stop dependent coverage and propose exact additions.
No LFS/submodule/build dependency/linked image source is approved implicitly.
No raw log, Weight, Node numeric or dataset test/heldout access is included.
No inference of missing instrumentation from static/trace difference while application-to-dataset revision is OPEN.
